record.field: ## Tool: Get Open Invoices Retrieves all unpaid or partially paid invoices for the customer linked to this lead. Returns invoice reference, due date, and outstanding amount. Use this tool when the user asks about open invoices, outstanding balance, or payment status.

## Tool: Get Late Payments Retrieves overdue invoices for the customer linked to this lead, including the number of days overdue and outstanding amounts. Use this tool when the user asks about late payments, payment history, or financial risk.

## Tool: Get Open Backorders Retrieves open backorders (incomplete deliveries) for the customer linked to this lead, including product names, ordered quantities and quantities already delivered. Use this tool when the user asks about pending deliveries, backorders, or stock shortages.

## Tool: Get Lead Communication Retrieves recent messages, emails, internal notes, and voice transcriptions from the lead's chatter, sorted newest first. Use this tool when the user asks about recent communication, email history, notes, or conversation summaries. Optional: provide a limit (default 20) to control how many messages to return.

## Tool: Get Logistics Issues Retrieves overdue or stalled deliveries/shipments for the customer linked to this lead (pickings that are past their scheduled date and not yet done). Use this tool when the user asks about delivery problems, late shipments, or supply chain issues.

## Tool: Create a Lead Creates a new CRM lead/opportunity record. Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to create a new lead and you have gathered the required name and description. Confirm details with the user before calling this tool.

## Tool: Save Customer Risk Assessment Writes the AI-generated risk assessment to the **x_customer_risk_assessment** field on this lead.
**Call this tool ONLY AFTER** you have already called: - Get Open Invoices - Get Late Payments - Get Open Backorders - Get Logistics Issues - Get Sale History (via the Sales topic)
…and have synthesised a complete risk assessment yourself.
The `assessment` text must include: - **Overall risk level**: Low / Medium / High - **Financial risk** (invoice amounts, days overdue, payment behaviour trend) - **Supply-chain risk** (open backorders, overdue deliveries) - **Strategic risk** (account size, buying trend, relationship warning signs) - **Summary sentence** with the key concern and recommended action

## Tool: Save Communication Sentiment Analysis Writes the AI-generated sentiment analysis to the **x_customer_messages_sentiment** field on this lead.
**Call this tool ONLY AFTER** you have called Get Lead Communication (use limit=50 to capture the full history) and analysed every message for its emotional tone.
The `sentiment_summary` text must include: - **Overall sentiment**: Positive / Neutral / Negative / Mixed - **Per-message breakdown**: date, author, label (happy, satisfied, neutral, frustrated, angry, sad, urgent) - **Outliers**: messages that deviate significantly from the overall tone (include date and reason) - **Actionable summary**: one sentence on what the tone means for the relationship and what to watch out for
